subject.title: [do not merge] refactor: flip sessions and transcripts to sqlite storage

question: After the branch is cleaned, rebased, and proven, should OpenClaw accept this one-way session storage migration and removal of the file-shaped Plugin SDK compatibility family in this release line?
rationale: The tracker establishes the database-first direction, but the permanent external SDK removal, downgrade consequences, and cross-channel persisted-state migration require an explicit owner decision beyond automated correctness checks.

options.title: Approve after cleanup and proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the integration candidate, but merge only after unrelated changes are removed and the final rebased head has inspectable upgrade, restart, lifecycle, recovery, channel, and Codex evidence.

options.title: Replace with a narrower integration branch
options.body: Preserve the accepted database-first design but rebuild the final landing branch from current main if resolving this branch's conflicts safely would retain excessive unrelated or obsolete churn.

recommendation.title: Approve after cleanup and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the integration candidate, but merge only after unrelated changes are removed and the final rebased head has inspectable upgrade, restart, lifecycle, recovery, channel, and Codex evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places Vincent Koc closest to the combined session accessor, database, Plugin SDK, and bundled Codex integration surface.
